ch41-open.title: Calendar
ch41-open.standfirst: The month calendar on your dashboard, with Korean and Vietnamese public holidays painted in.

c41-calendar.heading: A calendar that knows the holidays
c41-calendar.lead: The dashboard calendar lays your meetings out across the month and lets you create one on any day. It also paints the working week: Sundays and public holidays in red, Saturdays in blue, with Korean and Vietnamese public holidays fetched automatically for each year.
c41-calendar.body: Country-aware timing — showing a meeting in each attendee's own timezone — is planned but not yet available; for now times show in your own local time.
